Name: EpiSeedLink
Description:
The overreaching mission of EpiSeedLink is to foster a European network that empowers crop improvement through epigenetics by providing expertise, know-how, and creativity in high-end technologies to 11 early stage scientists and enabling them to translate scientific knowledge and skills into innovation. Through international, multidisciplinary, and inter-sectorial training in experimental and computational biology, EpiSeedLink will not only contribute to excellence in research but also timely address societal and agricultural needs. This original research program combines the unique know-how of academic experts with that of two seed companies to synergize research and knowledge transfer between a plant model (Arabidopsis) and a crop of enormous agroeconomic importance (oilseed rape). 
EpiSeedLink will exploit the epigenetic regulation of seed priming mechanisms to improve crop performance under threats caused by climate change (drought, heat, high light) through non-GMO practices. 
As a summary the Main Research Objectives are: 
•	to provide a “gene-to-field” applicability of new markers to produce or select varieties with an enhanced capacity for stress tolerance that, in the long term, will serve as a framework for knowledge transfer to other Brassica crops, to which various leafy vegetables, cauliflower/broccoli, mustard, and turnip belong.
 Oilseed rape is ideally suited to undertake the EpiSeedLink research program. On one hand, oilseed rape is Europe’s most important oils crop (for cereal and biofuel production) and is closely related to the model plant Arabidopsis. On the other hand, it is affected by environmental threats during the critical phases of germination and field emergence, such that the drought in 2018/19 caused up to 44% losses in the EU. The expertise of the BioAtlantis and DSV companies will beneficite as to achieve our objective.
•	 Provide excellent know-how, and improve research and complementary skills of 11 early-stage scientists

Name: UNLOCK project
Description:
15 partners from 7 EU countries work together to transform waste from the poultry industry into bio-based products for agricultural applications. 

The UNLOCK project, funded by the Bio-based Industries Joint Undertaking (BBI JU), aims at designing economically and environmentally sustainable innovative value chains to create a feather based bio-economy. 

In the course for the four-years project, the feathers will be valorised through four different processes, from mechanical treatment to steam explosion, microbial fermentaion or chemical hydrolysis, depending on the type of end products desired. 

The bio-based products generated will be tailored to the needs of the agriculture sector, with the creation of seed trays, nonwoven geotextiles, mulch films and hydroponic foams. Futhermore, the keratin contained in those innovative materials will bring additional environmental benefits at the end of the product’s life: keratin-based materials are targeted to be zero waste and allow for controlled biodegradability, while also enriching soils with organic nitrogen. 

The UNLOCK project is lead by the CIDETEC Foundation. It receives funding from the @EU_H2020 Research & Innovation Programme granted by 
@BBI2020 under grant agreement no 101023306. It officially started on 1st May 2021 and will run until April 2025.

Name: Biobank Ireland Trust
Description:
Biobank Ireland Trust was founded in 2004 by Ciaran Flanagan and Professor Eoin Gaffney. A Vodafone Ireland Foundation “World of Difference” award in August 2008 enabled Blanaid Mee to work with Biobank Ireland Trust. With Eoin Gaffney she set up the St James’s Hospital Cancer Biobank in the Department of Histopathology. The new biobank adopted the same honest broker (neutral minders of the samples) policy and procedures kindly provided by the Beaumont Hospital / RCSI Biobank, and the Irish Biobank Network effectively began in these two hospitals. Cork and Galway University Hospitals have adopted the same policies for consent and sample access. Funding for Biobank Ireland Trust has not been obtained from government to date.

Four out of ten people will be diagnosed with cancer during their lifetimes. The development of more effective, targeted treatments and tests for cancer depend on an increased understanding of the molecular mechanisms involved in the initiation of the tumour, its spread, and its response or resistance to treatment. Large research studies using quality tissue samples from patients with cancer collected and stored in biobanks are needed to correlate biology with clinical outcome. This is the rationale for an Irish Biobank Network.

Neuropath’s novel, first-in-class compounds are designed not only to harness the extraordinary multifactorial neurotherapeutic actions of the neuropeptide thyrotropin-releasing hormone (TRH), but also to overcome pharmacological limitations that, in the past, have hindered clinical exploitation of TRH-based neurotherapeutics.

Our approach is to selectively target TRH receptors in brain to deliver multiple neurotherapeutic effects that mitigate core aspects of relevant ND biology, thereby counteracting progressive failure of neuronal networks and reducing cognitive and motor impairments.  This distinct strategy aligns with increasing calls in the field for multifactorial neuroprotective interventions, and it leverages an extensive academic and pharma knowledge base for the target TRH system.

Supported by a robust IND/CTA-enabling work-up, Neuropath’s orphan-designated lead compound, JAK4D, is positioned for first-in-human/Phase 1 clinical studies.  The preclinical data package includes demonstration of proof-of-concept (PoC) in multiple clinically relevant models, a clean safety profile, and manufacturability.  One PoC study, published recently in Brain Communications, provides further strong evidence to support the capacity of JAK4D to mitigate cognitive dysfunction in NDs.

We are interested in connecting with investors and/or strategic development partners to join us in progressing this exciting prospect to capture an attractive neurotherapeutic target of longstanding pharma interest and major clinical and commercial potential in therapeutic areas of vast, pressing need. We are committed to developing novel and transformative medicines to create a better future for people in critical need of new treatment options. Our product portfolio is designed to make a significant impact on neurodegenerative and rare peripheral amyloid diseases, which affect millions of people and their families worldwide.

Name: Rinn Medical Devices
Description:
Rinn Medical Devices, established in 2026, is focused on supporting healthy ageing by developing medical device innovations that tackle the chronic conditions most likely to affect people as they age, from heart and kidney disease to neurological conditions, cancer, and beyond. 

Building on the outputs of CÚRAM, the Research Ireland Centre for Medical Devices (2015-2026), our work is guided by three core research areas, or clinical pillars: Cardiovascular-Renal-Metabolic health, Neurological health, and Cancer and Inflammatory conditions, reflecting  health challenges that matter most to older individuals and the people who care for them. 

To translate research into real devices that reach patients, these pillars are supported by three cutting-edge technology themes: host responsive devices, detection systems and the technology drivers that make it all possible. 

Our translational research programme brings together a wide range of experts, clinicians, regulators, statisticians, and financial and market specialists, to rigorously assess how early-stage discoveries can make the leap from the laboratory to clinical use.

At every step, patient voices, experiences, and priorities shape what we do and how we do it, ensuring that the devices we develop are not just scientifically sound, but genuinely meaningful to the people they're designed to help.

Name: ONK Therapeutics
Description:
ONK Therapeutics, is an innovative cell therapy company dedicated to developing a next generation of off-the-shelf, dual-targeted NK cell therapy platform targeting hematological malignancies and solid tumors.
The Company was founded in 2015, by Prof. O’Dwyer MD, of NUI Galway, an expert in translational multiple myeloma research, the tumour microenvironment, and exploitation of NK cells as cellular immunotherapy. 
Its core proprietary platform is based on a dual-targeted NK cell expressing both a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting a known tumour antigen and a TNF related apoptosis inducing ligand variant (TRAILv) targeting the death receptor pathway (i.e. DR4 or DR5).  
This promising new approach has the potential to enhance efficacy by addressing both intrinsic (e.g. CAR engagement of a tumor specific antigen) and extrinsic (e.g. signalling through the death receptor pathway) apoptotic pathways, and to reduce the susceptibility to possible target antigen escape through the engagement of tumor antigen independent TRAILv.

Name: Axio BioPharma
Description:
Axio BioPharma is building the vendor-neutral data infrastructure for biomanufacturing.

Biomanufacturing runs on a dozen enterprise systems that do not talk to each other. LIMS, MES, ELN, Historian, ERP, QMS, and more. Every tech transfer, every investigation, and every handoff between pharma sponsors and their manufacturing partners breaks on the same problem: critical process data is fragmented across organizational and technical boundaries.

We are not building AI models. We are building the coordination layer that makes AI possible.

Axio Lattice is a federated data platform that connects process data across sponsors and their manufacturing partners without centralizing it. Data stays in pharma's environment. Ownership never changes hands. Meaning is standardized through a neutral layer that works across every major enterprise system biomanufacturing depends on.

Axio Lab is a Madison-based, non-GMP, high-throughput antibody production facility. It delivers fee-for-service campaigns to biotech and pharma teams while generating the clean, structured datasets and commercial relationships that seed Lattice deployments.

We are vendor-neutral by design. Large manufacturers cannot host this network because sponsors will not put their process data on a competitor's platform. Pharma-built internal data teams cannot solve it alone because the problem is cross-organizational by definition. Axio sits between them, owned by neither, trusted by both.

Headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin. Backed by operators and advisors from Catalent, CrowdStrike, Danaher, and the Allen Institute.

If you are a sponsor, manufacturing partner, or technology vendor working on the data fragmentation problem, we would like to hear from you.

Name: Systems Biology Ireland
Description:
SBI established in 2009 under the Science Foundation Ireland CSET programme has successfully developed an integrated mathematical modelling and experimental research programme focusing on the design of new therapeutic approaches to cancer, degenerative and inflammatory diseases based on a systems level, mechanistic understanding of cellular signal transduction networks.

SBI is one of the few centres in Europe with the necessary in house expertise, technologies and capabilities to apply systems biology approaches to mammalian models. It’s recognition internationally within the field of systems biology led to the Centre’s invited participation in three large European funded consortia initiatives in 2012 namely the ITFoM, CASyM and ISBE, the last of which is included on the ESFRI 2010 Roadmap.

Research carried out at the Centre, significantly contributed to two successful large EU-FP7 multi-partner health proposals namely ASSET and PRIMES, both of which are coordinated by SBI and have a funding allocation in the region of €12 million each.

Since its inception in 2009, SBI has built up a highly skilled international work-force of approx. 80 staff, many of which have secured independent funding and contributed to SBI’s impressive track record to date

Name: Isogen Life Science
Description:
Already more than 30 years on the market, Isogen Life Science provides a wide range of instruments, reagents and consumables in the areas of cell biology, molecular biology and biochemistry. Our products are used by biotechnology companies and leading research institutes. 

Our headquarter is in De Meern, the Netherlands with sales operatives in Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg, Spain, Portugal and the UK. 

We have our own service organization qualified to also perform IQ/OQ/PQ.

We always look for new products that innovate life science research and diagnostics.

Interested to see what we can offer you to bring your research to the next level? Please contact get in contact with our experts via info@isogen-lifescience.com or call +31 30 6880771

Name: PrecisionBioticsTM
Description:
PrecisionBioticsTM has a long-standing reputation for developing products supported by rigorous scientific research. Founded 25 years ago, by scientists who believed the human microbiome contains the answers to many modern health problems. Our scientists began researching thousands of bacterial cultures together with experts from one of the world's leading centres of microbiome research, the APC Microbiome Institute. From the very start, we have been dedicated to understanding unique bacterial strains and their role in specific areas of health.

Today, we are part of Novonesis a leading global biosolutions company formed through a combination of Chr. Hansen and Novozymes. We now have access to the world’s largest collection of bacterial strains and thousands of enzymes that help further our dedication to find sustainable solutions for future generations. Our unique heritage and expertise allow us to look for one-in-a-trillion solutions and empower people to live healthier, happier lives.

We are proud to have supported many research studies, led by healthcare professionals and academic experts from across the world.

We welcome applications for funding and support for clinical and real-world research proposals relating to our probiotic strains, the gut microbiome and related topics.

Name: SeqBiome
Description:
SeqBiome is a world leading microbiome contract research company, providing first in class technical and scientific services to researchers in leading companies in the Pharma, Food, and Nutrition industries and to academic researchers in top Universities.

SeqBiome measures, analyzes, and interprets the microbiome using state-of-the-art tools, partnering with industry and academia to offer custom sequencing and bioinformatics services. We are committed to helping our customers derive actionable insights from their projects.

SeqBiome offers an end-to-end Microbiome analysis service for our customers. We add most value to our customers by being involved early in their study and we can assist them with Statistical Study Design, Sample Processing, Metagenomic Sequencing, Compositional and Functional Microbiome Analysis, Biostatistical and Bioinformatic Analysis, and Publication/Patent Ready Outputs.

Name: Hello Bio
Description:
Hello Bio was founded by a team of experienced scientists and chemists who genuinely want to support life science research. Our aim is to manufacture and supply a range of high quality life science tools at prices so low that as many researchers as possible will be able to afford them.

We offer a range of agonists, antagonists, inhibitors, activators, antibodies and fluorescent tools at up to half the price of other suppliers including:
*Enzyme inhibitors and activators
*Epigenetic tools
*Ion channel modulators
*Receptor ligands 
*Signaling tools
*Stem cell modulators and more...

With an expert chemistry team, we also offer a cost effective custom synthesis service for customers requiring specialist tools, or bulk quantities.

Based in the UK, Hello Bio was founded by life science entrepreneur Steve Roome PhD. The company supplies high quality and affordable life science tools to researchers in universities, pharmaceutical companies and research institutes around the world.

Name: Centre for Applied Bioscience Research (CABR)
Description:
Centre for Applied Bioscience Research (CABR)’s vision is to be a leading centre for the development and application of science and technology to applied settings, in collaboration with external organisations, and based on our own research. 

CABR is a Research Centre and part of the Enterprise Ireland Technology Gateway Programme. The Enterprise Ireland Technology Gateway Programme is co-financed by the Government of Ireland and the European Union through the ERDF Southern, Eastern & Midland Regional Programme 2021-27 and the Northern & Western Regional Programme 2021-27.

CABR is a collaboration between the Munster Technological University and Technological University of the Shannon: Midlands Midwest.

The Centre brings together a multidisciplinary team of researchers with commercial specialists so as to provide a centre of excellence in applied research, capable of exploiting opportunities in science and technology to the benefit of the Regional and National economy.

CABR has developed significant expertise in bioresources – detection, identification, characterisation and valorisation – and collaborates with industry and other research centres in order to deliver this expertise in applied settings.

CABR responds to the challenges of Biotech, Food and Life Science Industries through the sustainable development of viable and cost-effective processes and products from bio-resources. This development is driven through collaborative research and development, providing risk management and opportunity identification for our clients, partners and researchers. 

CABR’s state of the art facilities and equipment are available to assist companies to address specific challenges. For more information on our facilities and equipment please see www.cabr.ie.

Name: Globyz Biopharma Services
Description:
Globyz is a global biopharma supply chain and commercialization partner, supporting pharmaceutical,  biotechnology & medical device companies from clinical development through commercial launch.

We simplify complex market entry and supply chain challenges by offering an integrated, end-to-end solution—from Importer of Record (IOR) and regulatory support to GMP/GDP-compliant storage, temperature-controlled logistics, and distribution.

Our capabilities include:
• Clinical trial supply & comparator sourcing
• Packaging, labeling, and global logistics
• Importation & Drug Establishment License (DEL) support
• 3PL warehousing & cold chain distribution
• QA, PV, Market Access and commercialization support

Globyz works with biotech innovators, specialty pharma companies, generic companies and global manufacturers to streamline operations and accelerate timelines across North America, Europe, and other key markets.

With a strong focus on Canada and US commercialization, we act as a one-stop partner—reducing reliance on multiple vendors and minimizing execution risk.

At Globyz, we believe that successful launches are not defined by regulatory approval alone, but by execution excellence. Our integrated model enables faster market entry, improved compliance, and reliable product availability—ensuring therapies reach patients safely and efficiently.

Name: Stoelting Europe
Description:
Welcome to Stoelting Europe, a leading provider of instruments and software for pre-clinical neuroscience research. With our commitment to scientific advancements and tradition of innovation, we empower academic researchers in their pursuit of knowledge while ensuring the utmost care and adherence to the principles of the 3Rs in animal research.

Neuroscience is at the forefront of scientific exploration. At Stoelting Europe, we are proud to contribute to its progress. By equipping researchers with advanced instruments and software, we empower them to unlock the mysteries of the brain and behaviour.

We deliver high-quality instruments, meticulously tested and validated to ensure superior performance. Our Stereotaxic Instruments division offers reliable and precise tools that researchers trust for their intricate procedures. Simultaneously, our ANY-maze Behavioural Tracking Software division provides sophisticated software solutions that streamline data analysis and provide valuable insights. Our dedicated team of science professionals provides prompt, knowledgeable customer service, supporting your research journey at every step.

Visit our website to explore our catalogue, discover how Stoelting Europe's Stereotaxic Instruments and ANY-maze Behavioural Tracking Software can elevate your research, and make a lasting impact. Choose excellence in research with Stoelting Europe.

Name: Metabolomic Diagnostics
Description:
Metabolomic Diagnostics is a deep-tech company specialised in the development of novel biomarker based diagnostic solutions for complex diseases. The company has developed an effective pipeline to firstly identify diagnostic biomarker panels and then translate these panels into clinical assays ready for application in the clinical laboratory.

Metabolomic Diagnostics’ primary vision is to develop a portfolio of diagnostic solutions which can determine, early in a woman’s pregnancy,
her risk of developing major complications much later in her pregnancy and thus enabling personalized care, adapted to each woman’s individual needs. Pregnancy complications like preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, preterm birth, and in-uterine growth restriction, all have the potential to severely impact on the well-being of mother and child.

Name: ERS Genomics
Description:
ERS Genomics was formed to commercialise the foundational CRISPR-Cas9 intellectual property held by co-inventor, co-owner and Nobel Prize-winner Dr. Emmanuelle Charpentier. Licenses are available in multiple fields of use.

CRISPR-Cas9 is a revolutionary new genome editing technology, which offers significant advantages in speed, efficiency and cost over earlier genome editing methods. 

Our team has decades of experience in the field of genome editing and its application, in business development and licensing, licensing preclinical and clinical stage therapeutic products and drug delivery technologies, genome editing technologies as well as overseeing research and development.

To learn more about acquiring your license, contact us today.

Name: Safira Clinical Research Limited
Description:
We founded Safira to improve the patient experience during their clinical trial journey. We do this by supporting technology partners and sponsors in designing patient-facing technologies and their use in clinical trial protocols. Safira provides the support services that new companies with innovative technologies are often in need of to bring their technologies into the clinical trial space.

We are the "One Stop Shop" for eCOA services in clinical research for Sponsors, Tech Partners and CROs.

We conduct research with patients to establish a better understanding of how technology in Decentralized Clinical Trials can reduce their burden and at the same time complies with regulatory demands.

We regularly publish our findings in peer-reviewed journals and present at conferences to share our findings. Current topics of interest are BYOD, Wearable Devices, AI/ML and their application in clinical research.

While we have a clear focus on eCOA, we are also experienced in IRT, eConsent and EDC.

We provided User Acceptance Testing as a Service for more than 10 years now and we partner with multiple vendors and sponsors to assure a quality product is released to the end users (patients and site staff)

We offer excellent training to new joiners in the eCOA space and provide advanced training for more experienced peers in the industry.

License Management can be cumbersome and complex. Our dedicated License Management team will take the complexity out of this process and supports Sponsors and CROs to get it right. We also offer license audits to Sponsors to assure compliance with existing contracts and agreements.

Name: BD-GenCell Biosystems
Description:
GenCell Biosystems is a developer of innovative biological testing instruments based in Limerick, Ireland.  Founded in 2011, currently employs over 60 people. GenCell Biosystems was acquired by BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) on Oct 13, 2014

BD-GenCell Biosystems provides biology with robust, high performance systems to perform analysis faster and at lower cost than is currently possible. 

BD-GenCell’s platform Composite Liquid Cell technology mirrors nature by performing tests within inert synthetic cells. These Composite Liquid Cells are an ideal environment to perform biological chemistry. 

Commercial instrument configurations include:
•	Library preparation for next generation sequencing
•	High throughput genotyping
•	High throughput DNA extraction
•	Live cell screening for compound testing

To-date we have partnered with a number of established biotech companies to develop instrumentation for multiple applications.  The company also collaborates with various worldwide universities to continuously develop innovative technologies.

Name: Weatherbys Scientific
Description:
Today one of Europe’s premier facilities, Weatherbys Scientific in Ireland has been involved in animal parentage testing since 1985.

The laboratory has been accredited with CSPro certification by Illumina,  has ISO 17025 certification and is also accredited by The International Committee for Animal Recording (ICAR).

We are continuously expanding our range of services to match the needs of the industry.

Initially the laboratory offered a blood typing service to confirm pedigrees, as part of foal registration. Then, in 1990, the laboratory extended this to the non-thoroughbred sector as part of the registration of foals for the Irish Horse Board.

The laboratory introduced DNA technology at the beginning of this century. This superseded blood-typing and provided further opportunities to confirm pedigrees of other animal species such as cattle, sheep, dogs and cats. The Laboratory is now offering its services to the Irish and British livestock industries.

It is recognised by the International Society of Animal Genetics (ISAG) as one of the leading laboratories in the world in pedigree verification. It is the only such laboratory in Ireland recognised by ISAG to have achieved the necessary standards in multi-species parentage testing.

In January 2011 the laboratory introduced cattle genomic testing. This enhances the prediction values for the estimated breeding index (EBI) of individual breeding stock in the livestock industry. We are now genotyping with the bovine IDB V3, 54K and 770K (HD) SNP chips to increase reliability of genetic predictions in the livestock industry

Name: Brandon Bioscience
Description: Brandon Bioscience is a marine biotechnology company based in Tralee, Co. Kerry that specialise in the production of precision biostimulants. We are driven by science, inspired by nature, and committed to improving crop yields and quality while respecting the environment. With 25 years of experience, we are the trusted experts in plant biostimulants and pioneers in sustainable agriculture.

Name: Red Box Direct
Description:
Red Box Direct was founded in 2006 to give life‐science instrument manufacturers a direct gateway to customers in Europe and Asia. 

From our Dublin headquarters, we help life‐science brands expand their global reach and reduce tariff impact by providing outsourced sales, marketing, manufacturing and support services. 

With offices in Ireland, Hong Kong and Japan, RedBoxDirect operates as a partner rather than a traditional distributor. We manage local sales teams and logistics while you keep control of your pricing, brand and customer relationships. 

Today the company represents more than 20 brands and serves over 30 European universities across multiple countries. Our goal is to enable customers to expand their businesses internationally through a transparent, outsourced solution.

Name: Polypico Technologies Ltd
Description:
Polypico Technologies Ltd. is a provider of innovative fluid dispensing technology based in Cork, Ireland. Founded in 2012, the privately owned company designs, and manufactures, fluid dispensing solutions for both Life Science and Industrial applications.

Polypico technology enables new applications and possibilities and provides a new set of solutions for low volume fluid dispensing applications.

Polypico’s core platform technology is based on a new innovation in non-contact ultra low volume acoustic dispensing. This platform technology brings new features, benefits and possibilities to applications where precision low volume fluid dispensing is required.

We are focused on revolutionising the way bio-materials and other fluids are printed and dispensed. Our versatile technology combats challenges such as: cross-contamination; dispenser clogging; wastage due to minimum usable volumes; and system complexity, through the use of simple disposable fluid cartridges.
Our multidisciplinary team have a broad range of expertise in areas such as: micro-fluidics; electronics; software development; mechanical engineering; business development and bio-technology.

Polypico technology enables new applications and possibilities and provides a new set of solutions for low volume fluid dispensing applications. We offer customised solution and services for the Life Sciences and Industrial applications.

Name: Dementia Research Network Ireland (DRNI)
Description: An all-Ireland interdisciplinary dementia and neurodegenerative research initiative. DRNI aims to integrate knowledge and practice from diverse academic research and clinical disciplines, as well as government, community and voluntary sectors to significantly impact the understanding of dementia and neurodegeneration and to make a lasting national and international contribution to research and policy making in the area.

Name: Pplus Medical Limited
Description:
Pplus Medical was founded in 2014 by the award-winning clinician and scientist, Dr. Mitra Najafi, an expert in PRP technology. Initially using her own funds and later with the support of third-party investors, Dr. Najafi and her team developed, patented, and CE marked several pioneering products. Two of these products are already on the market, being utilized by some of the most prestigious universities and laboratories worldwide in areas such as Haematology, Thrombosis, Haemophilia, Drug Discovery, Drug Delivery, Thrombocytopenia, Platelet Diseases, Rare Diseases, and many more.

 PRP Digital Storage Device: Designed for the storage of PRP or platelets at room temperature for up to 7 days.

 Learn more about the PRP Digital Storage Device
Whether you are using PRP in your clinic or laboratory, you can store and preserve PRP at room temperature for up to 7 days using our patented and CE marked DSD which is the culmination of over 10 years of research, testing, and development in collaboration with several universities and laboratories in Europe and the USA. It all started from  the findings of a peer-reviewed study with the haematology lab at St. Thomas' Hospital in London, published in the British Journal of Biomedical Science in 2016

 CRP-A: The new generation of collagen-related peptides, a superior platelet activator working via GPVI receptors.

 Learn more about CRP-A
CRP-A is fast becoming the platelet activator of choice for the world's leading researchers in platelets and coagulation. Since its launch, we have received excellent feedback from scientists around the world. CRP-A offers increased stability, batch-to-batch consistency, high purity and yield, unrivalled potency in activating platelets via GPVI receptors, and a 2-year shelf life.

 COMING SOON!  Learn more about our upcoming products
Our patented and clinically proven non-invasive skin regenerative treatment using the patient's own PRP is on the horizon.

Name: Marama Labs
Description:
MaramaLabs’ CloudSpec instrument has a valuable capability for UV-Vis analysis – it can measure through cloudy liquids.  If you think of all the liquids you encounter daily you will begin to appreciate how much of a stumbling block this is for UV-Vis. CloudSpec’s novel ability – scatter-corrected absorption (SCA) spectroscopy – enables quantitative analysis of the constituents of cloudy liquids quickly and easily.
CloudSpec is a perfect fit for nanomedicine development, manufacturing and quality control.  Nanomedicines are too small to see but they protect and deliver new classes of drugs – vaccines, oncological treatments, gene therapies and more – safely and effectively into the body.  With CloudSpec, drug developers can quantify potency in seconds, accurately and easily, for substantial time and cost savings.

Name: Genseq
Description:
Genseq provides best-in-class, next-generation sequencing services to the Biopharma and Clinical Research sectors worldwide.   

Our CAP-accredited laboratory has the capacity to generate the highest quality multiomic data at scale to meet our customers’ diverse project goals.

Name: EIRNABio
Description: Harnessing the Power of Translatomics. Enabling Bioinnovations. Contact us at info@eirnabio.com .

Name: Teagasc Bioprocessing
Description:
Bioprocess Innovation Suite at Teagasc
 Innovating sustainable bioprocessing and biotechnology.

The Bioprocess Innovation Suite at Teagasc is a hub for advancing fermentation science and microbial biotechnology. We deliver innovative solutions for food and biotechnology industries by leveraging cutting-edge tools and expertise.

Our capabilities include:

 - Precision fermentation for developing microbial cell factories and bioactives.

 - High-throughput strain screening with BioLector and RoboLector systems.

 - Access to the extensive Teagasc Culture Collection of over 8,000 isolates for strain discovery and development.

 - Bioreactors ranging from bench-scale to pilot-scale, supporting process optimisation and scalability.

 - Expertise in valorising waste streams, transforming by-products into high-value resources.

 - Comprehensive downstream processing facilities, both within Teagasc and through collaboration with Moorepark Technology Ltd. (MTL), which provides pilot commercial-scale fermentation and advanced processing capabilities.

We are dedicated to unlocking the potential of microbes for sustainable production of food, bioactives and biotechnological innovations.

 Follow us for updates on our work in precision fermentation, waste valorisation, and microbial biotechnology.

 Learn more: Teagasc Bioprocess Innovation Suite

Join us in shaping a sustainable, innovative future for bioprocessing and biotechnology!

Name: Plusvital
Description: Plusvital is a leader in equine science and nutrition, dedicated to empowering equine performance through scientifically advanced supplements and services. Founded in 1975 and headquartered in Ireland, Plusvital harnesses the latest scientific research to develop supplement products that optimize equine health, performance, and welfare. With a commitment to innovation, quality, and excellence, Plusvital is trusted by top riders, trainers, and breeders worldwide

Name: Nexomic
Description: We’re here to decode cancer biology and turn it into meaningful breakthroughs.

Name: DCU Life Sciences Institute
Description: Dublin City University's Life Sciences Institute

Name: Orbsen Therapeutics Limited
Description:
Orbsen Therapeutics Limited aims to become a leading company in the development of regenerative medicine therapies across a range of diseases and medical conditions. We are developing a novel proprietary technology that permits the isolation of pure and defined stomal cells from human tissue and a range of other species. The multi-species elements allow our technology to move seamlessly from the research laboratories to the clinic.

The technology is designed to ensure that resulting therapies comply with the forthcoming stringent EMA and UK BSI guidelines regarding the purity and definition of cellular therapies. We believe that our technology will set the standard for regenerative medicine into the future.

Orbsen Therapeutics was originally formed in 2006 as a spin out company from REMEDI, Ireland's Regenerative Medicine Institute in NUI Galway. Founded and led by some of the leading scientists in the field of regenerative medicine we operate from within the Orbsen Building, on campus at NUI Galway, which houses REMEDI's state of the art research facilities.

The company has already participated in EU FP7 funded research progammes and has a significant research pipeline coming to fruition over the coming years.

Name: Aurora Scientific
Description:
For over thirty years Aurora Scientific measurement instrumentation has been the choice of leading science researchers around the world. Our selection of dual mode lever systems and force transducers are used in a broad array of life science research specialties including exercise and metabolism, cardiology, injury recovery, gerontology, disease progression and pharmacology, and more. Our fast response sensors are considered benchmark instruments in olfaction research studying odor dynamics and pheromone/plume dispersion, and our mechanical stimulator technology is used in studies of the neuronal response to touch, pain and stretch. Many instruments have also been adapted for use by material science researchers studying the properties of artificial muscle, locomotion and nanomaterials. Legacy instruments used in the field of environmental monitoring and mine operations are still in use today.

Aurora Scientific is committed to creating products that answer questions and solve problems. We value excellence, innovation, responsiveness and the satisfaction of a job well done. And we share the researcher’s desire to broaden the boundaries of knowledge and understanding.

Name: Stoelting Co.
Description:
Stoelting's Neuroscience division is a  leading manufacturer and distributor of scientific research equipment pertaining specifically to the brain and behavior.  We proudly offer a complete line of behavioral testing equipment, anchored by ANY-maze; an easy to use video tracking software that provides automated analysis of multiple behavioral paradigms.  Moreover, our world-renowned line of stereotaxic instruments can be found in laboratories world-wide. 
At Stoelting, we are proud of our tradition of innovation, and we shall always have a strong commitment to support scientific research.  We seek to offer only high quality, reliable instruments, and support them with prompt, educated customer service from our staff of science professionals.

Name: All-Island Cancer Research Institute (AICRI)
Description: AICRI will bring together the combined strengths of cancer researchers on this island of Ireland to tackle cancer, linking with US and other international colleagues. Our mission is to provide an overarching framework for cancer research across the island of Ireland, from discovery to implementation, for the benefit of cancer patients and wider society. Progressing the vision of AICRI, our ethos is “With the patient; around the patient; for the patient”.

Name: RemedyBio
Description: RemedyBio is an immunology-focused discovery and development company based in Dublin, Ireland. It has pioneered a new approach to understanding the immune system and the discovery of new therapies.

Name: Hooke Bio Ltd.
Description:
Hooke Bio Ltd. was founded in 2014 by Professor Mark Davies at Stokes Laboratories, University of Limerick (UL), a research center which has a rich history of microfluidic entrepreneurship. Hooke Bio spun out from UL in 2017 and  has been based in Shannon, Co. Clare, Ireland since 2019. 

To date, Hooke Bio have been awarded up to 12M in investment from a combination of private, angel and public funds.  A portion of this has come from the prestigious European Innovation Council (EIC) Accelerator funding of which Hooke was awarded 5.7M (blended finance) in 2023.  Hooke Bio recently launched their service option with hardware launch of their Mera system scheduled for late 2025. Most recently in Dec 2024, Hooke were successful in the DTIF Call 7 with Relevium Medical and the University of Galway on the RestOAre project worth €4.6M. Hooke Bio also have 3 patents protecting their technology as well as a freedom to operate. 

The company  has consistently been supported from investors (Boole Investment Syndicate and Irrus Investments) and the Western Development Commission. The Hooke Bio premises in Clare consists of Engineering Labs (optics/microfluidics/electronic), a class II biological laboratory and a fully kitted out toolroom.

Name: Biostór Ireland
Description:
At Biostór Ireland Ltd, our success is driven by a culture of collaboration, innovation and determination. We believe in progressive thinking, in challenging ourselves and each other, with the goal of enhancing patient outcomes and patient lives. Our mission is to serve our customers with the highest quality, ethics and practices, and to provide best in class customer service & client experience. 
We are a Bio repository for temperature critical storage of bio materials & a choice of controlled storage conditions down to -196°C (Liquid Nitrogen Vapour) and a range of validated cold-chain distribution services. 

Biostór is validated to GMP standards. The Quality Management System is designed to comply with applicable EU & US regulations and international standards: ISO 13485:2003. The company has been audited and approved by major US FDA regulated multinational pharmaceutical companies. 

Our operations are subject to stringent regulation as set down by EU Tissues & Cells Directives. In March 2008 the facility was inspected and accredited by the Irish Medicines Board (IMB) as a Tissue Establishment for the GTP storage and distribution of Human Tissues and Cells for human application throughout the 27 member countries of the EU.

Biostór can cater for a wide range of sample types: Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) and Finished Products, Clinical Trial Samples, Donor Materials, Plasma, Serum and Body Fluids, Human Tissues and Cell Products i.e., Bone Marrow, Cord Blood & Reproductive Cells.  The company currently maintains the national archive of Bone Marrow, Peripheral Stem Cells and Donor Lymphocytes for the country’s main cancer hospital.

Biostór Ireland is located at Rosslare Harbour, Co. Wexford, 2km from the international Europort with fast road/ferry transit times to UK & Europe, 2 hours by road from Dublin/Cork airports with overnight courier service to all European centres. The store has a current capacity for 5 million biological samples.

Name: Gerard Laboratories Mylan
Description: Gerard Laboratories Mylan is a biotechnology company based out of 35 Baldoyle Industrial Estate, Dublin, Co Dublin, Ireland.

Name: Celtic Biotech Ltd
Description:
Celtic Biotech is developing novel candidate therapies for the treatment of solid cancers and pain in humans. Derived from specialised receptor binding proteins found in snake venom, these product candidates have the potential to increase survival,  improve quality-of-life and reduce treatment costs for cancer patients.

Celtic Biotech is focusing its research on solid tumours, including non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC), as its initial targets.  The Company's lead candidate, CB-24 (Crotoxin), has been observed to be highly toxic to various tumour cell lines in pre-clinical and early clinical studies.

Name: CanVas platform powered by HAON
Description:
The CanVas platform is spearheading the development of investigational allogeneic candidates for neurologic, rare and other serious diseases.

Our world class team are dedicated to advancing a wave of investigational allogeneic products through excellence in translational research, clinical development and cell manufacturing.

We are developing a pipeline of off-the-shelf cell therapies based on the pioneering Can-Vas platform. This could allow for the delivery of cell therapies to patients faster when they need it most and at greater scale.

 

Our mission is to have a transformative impact on patients’ lives by creating cell therapies for serious diseases where there are currently limited treatment options. Our aim is to help make longer and healthier lives a reality for more people.

To learn more contact us on Linkedin or at info@haonco.com.

Name: Algaebrew
Description:
AlgaeBrew is a research project with the objective to develop scalable processes that use microalgae (Nannochloropsis) to upgrade brewery wastewater and spent grain into high-value fatty acids to be used as a sustainable ingredient in the feed industry. The residual algae biomass after the fat extraction will be developed into biofertiliser to achieve a zero-waste goal. The project addresses technical challenges associated with algae cultivation on brewery waste, fatty acid extraction, feed formulation, and socio-economic analysis. 

The consortium exists out of a partnership of excellent international researchers and a brewery and feed company. Together they aim to develop circular biobased solutions based on a zero waste principle. 

Algaebrew receives financial support through the partners of the Joint Call of the Cofund ERA-NETs SUSFOOD2 (Grant N° 727473) and FOSC (Grant N° 862555).

Name: Oncomark
Description: OncoMark Ltd. is a private company centred on the development and application of biomarker panels, particularly supporting oncology drug development. A major focus of the company is to provide the link from -omic level discovery to validation via the use of multiplex antibody-based assays and high-throughput tissue microarray screening. OncoMark also conducts in-house research and development to (1) create unique multi-marker assays for use in the discrimination of patient response to drug therapies and (2) apply novel in-house image analysis toolkit for assessment of IHC-based markers at the subcellular compartmental level [IHC-MARK]. This is of particular benefit to the pharmaceutical and health authority sectors.

Name: O'Flaherty Lab
Description: Welcome to the official LinkedIn page for Prof. Vincent O'Flaherty's group at the University of Galway!  We are passionate about microbial ecology and its diverse applications, driving advancements in technology to foster a sustainable world.  From pioneering research in low-temperature anaerobic digestion to innovative biorefinery solutions utilizing industrial waste for VFA and PHA production, our work spans a wide spectrum.  Additionally, we are committed to mitigating greenhouse gas emissions from slurry and ruminant sources, contributing to a greener future for all. Join us in our journey towards sustainable innovation!  #MicrobialEcology #SustainableTechnology #Research #Innovation

Name: ATMP Ireland
Description:
ATMP.ie is Ireland’s first one-stop web portal where you can learn about the latest activities happening in advanced medicines and vaccines and make connections with the range of companies, academic institutions, researchers, and government agencies working in the area.

ATMP Ireland is a voluntary cross-sector group, called the CGT Forum, which was established with the aim of making Ireland and global leader for the development, manufacture, supply and adoption of advanced therapies.

Name: SHIELD Doctoral Network
Description:
SHIELD (Strategies for Healing Implant-associated infections and Enhancing Longevity in Devices) is a prestigious EU-funded Doctoral Network dedicated to advancing the management of implant-related infections. It provides a unique interdisciplinary platform for 16 talented early-career researchers to pursue their PhDs across 26 institutions in 11 countries, including universities and industry partners in Europe, Switzerland, and the US. 

Focusing on innovative approaches in regenerative medicine, biomaterials, and translational research, SHIELD aims to develop cutting-edge solutions that improve patient outcomes and extend the longevity of medical devices through collaboration across orthopedics, otology, and odontology.

Name: Equilume
Description: Performance lighting solutions for horses. Leaders in innovative lighting solutions to maximise performance and reproductive efficiency for horses.

Name: Inflection Biosciences Ltd
Description:
Inflection Biosciences Ltd is developing small molecule therapeutics for the treatment of cancer, inflammatory and autoimmune diseases. The company's pipeline was licensed from the Spanish National Cancer Research Centre (CNIO). IBL-101 is a pan-PIM kinase inhibitor in development for autoimmune and inflammatory disease. IBL-202 is a first-in-class, dual PIM kinase and PI3K inhibitor in development for B-cell malignancies, AML and multiple myeloma.  The partnered pipeline comprises AUM302, a PIM/PI3K/mTOR inhibitor being developed by AUM Biosciences. For more information please visit www.inflectionbio.com

Inflection Biosciences Ltd总部位于都柏林和伦敦,正在开发小分子癌症治疗药物。公司的创新抗癌药产品线授权来自西班牙国立癌症研究中心(CNIO)。该产品线包括IBL-300系列(PIM/PI3K/mTOR抑制剂),选自一系列独特的双机制激酶抑制剂的IBL-202(PIM/PI3K抑制剂),以及IBL-100系列(选择性泛PIM激酶抑制剂),目前在临床前期开发阶段。现有的数据显示产品对一系列难治性实体肿瘤和血液学恶性肿瘤有潜在的应用。Inflection Biosciences在14年被爱尔兰制药奖评为年度最佳初创企业。 欲了解进一步信息,请访问www.inflectionbio.com。

Name: Cellix
Description:
Cellix is dedicated to providing our customers with easy-to-use benchtop instruments for cell analysis, cell sorting and customised solutions for microfluidics. 

Cellix was spun-out from Trinity College Dublin in 2006 when we launched our VenaFlux and Microfluidic Solutions ranges. Name: The COBRA Toolbox
Description:
The openCOBRA project:

The openCOBRA project has arisen to provide researchers with easy access to core COBRA methodologies, and to provide a repository for community contributed modules that build off of these core COBRA features. The openCOBRA project was initiated with tools for MATLAB but has now grown to include Python and Julia-based modules for dealing with the complex relationships of the next generation of COBRA models.
The openCOBRA project is lead by Ronan Fleming from the Leiden University, Ines Thiele from the National University of Ireland Galway, Nikolaus Sonnenschein from the Technical University of Denmark, and Nathan Lewis from UCSD.

The COBRA approach:

The COnstraints Based Reconstruction and Analysis (COBRA) approach to systems biology accepts the fact that we do not possess sufficiently detailed parameter data to precisely model, in the biophysical sense, an organism at genome-scale.

Increasingly, omics data has been used to define the set of feasible states for a biological network in a given condition based on current knowledge. These constraints include compartmentalization, mass conservation, molecular crowding, and thermodynamic directionality. More recently, transcriptome data have been used to reduce the size of the set of computed feasible states.

Although COBRA methods may not provide a unique solution, they provide a reduced set of solutions that may be used to guide biological hypothesis development. Given its success, COBRA has attracted attention from many investigators and has developed rapidly in recent years based on contributions from a growing number of laboratories – COBRA methods have been used in hundreds of studies to deal with the complex relationships and high dimensionality of the next generation of COBRA models.

The COBRA Toolbox:

The COBRA Toolbox is coordinated by Ronan Fleming from the Leiden University and includes the following packages:

The COBRA Toolbox, MATLAB.devTools, COBRA.binary.

Name: Onkydra
Description:
Onkydra is the in-silico stratification workspace for rare-cancer drug development.

Drop in a target and the workspace simulates how it would perform across a virtual patient cohort drawn from real pooled patient data. It predicts the responder subgroup with confidence intervals resampled over the real anchor cohort, ranks the resistance pathways most likely to emerge first under selection pressure, and backs every claim with a citation at source. Then it keeps watching ClinVar, DepMap and the literature, and re-runs when something moves.

The engine runs on the Gemini 3 family, scPRINT-2 for transcriptomic perturbation, and Geneformer as an independent second opinion, with DepMap, LINCS L1000 and PubMed for anchoring and retrieval. An Honesty Critic flags where the models disagree and blocks any claim it cannot cite. The disagreement is the product.

Onkydra is for research use only. It is a hypothesis generator and prioritisation engine, not a diagnostic, not a treatment recommender, and not a medical device.

The beachhead indication, H3 K27M diffuse midline glioma, is live. Seven more rare and paediatric indications are on the roadmap, for a launch set of eight.

Recurring plans: Researcher at €99 per month, Biotech team at €499 per month per seat, and Founder portfolio at €2,500 per month.

Onkydra is a Gemini XPRIZE 2026 entry. The waitlist is live at onkydra.com.

Name: PRIME Prosections
Description:

We work to improve the study of medicine through classroom use of plastinated prosections. Our prosections are professionally dissected and plastinated for the sole purpose of higher anatomical learning. They are custom-made to meet the needs of the current and evolving curricular purposes of the school.

In our teaching work, we have seen a trend of growing enrollment in medical studies while department budgets decline. Because a good education in medicine relies on a deep, comprehensive, hands-on knowledge of human anatomy, this trend makes delivering a good education difficult. Traditionally, access to specimens is limited by a school’s budget. Prime seeks to remove that limitation through plastinated prosections.

Name: CODONZ
Description:
CODONZ Research Laboratory is an independent computational omics research laboratory founded by Umar Amjid, dedicated to advancing scientific discovery through bioinformatics, computational biology, and data-driven life sciences. Our research focuses on understanding the fundamental biological mechanisms that govern life by integrating computational approaches with modern omics technologies.

Our expertise spans computational genomics, metagenomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, systems biology, structural biology, microbiome research, mathematical and statistical modeling, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and high-performance computing (HPC). We develop and apply innovative computational methods to analyze complex biological data, uncover biological mechanisms, and generate insights that contribute to precision medicine, infectious disease research, biotechnology, agriculture, and environmental sustainability.

Guided by the One Health approach, we recognize the interconnected nature of human, animal, and environmental health. Through interdisciplinary collaboration, rigorous scientific research, and reproducible computational workflows, we strive to bridge the gap between biological data and meaningful scientific discovery.

Beyond research, CODONZ actively promotes Open Science through CODONZ Ed, our educational and scientific communication initiative that provides free access to learning resources, tutorials, workshops, and knowledge-sharing opportunities. We believe scientific knowledge should be open, accessible, and shared for the benefit of society.

At CODONZ, we are driven by curiosity, innovation, and scientific integrity. Our mission is to explore biological complexity, discover the mechanisms that shape living systems, develop innovative computational solutions, and translate knowledge into discoveries that advance science and improve human, animal, and environmental health.

Name: SWAEV
Description: SWAEV is an independent deep-tech research venture developing next-generation subquadratic architectures for structural genomics. Traditional genomic foundation models scale quadratically, resulting in massive, multi-million-dollar compute bottlenecks when deployed on high-resolution 2D spatial mapping tasks. SWAEV eliminates this infrastructure overhead by replacing global attention matrices with factorizable wave kernels that scale at a flat O(n) complexity. Our core architecture framework, GoldBEAM, delivers an order-of-magnitude reduction in operational hardware footprints, enabling base-resolution 3D chromatin folding predictions, generative regulatory knock-ins, and intrinsic biophysical property mapping at an elite, production-grade scale.
